paths..config/git/local: Set your private identity here using git config --file ~/.config/git/local user.email <email>

executables.mise: Needed to install and activate configured development tools

executables.Hyprland: Needed to run the window manager
executables.hyprctl: Needed to reload and validate Hyprland configuration
executables.1password: Opened at Hyprland login so the SSH agent can be unlocked

paths..config/hypr/hyprland.lua: Omarchy's main loader must load the personal override modules

executables.git: Used by the Git prompt and aliases
executables.uv: Used by Python and editor aliases

executables.qs: Quickshell provides the Wayland idle monitor; already included in Omarchy
executables.systemctl: Used to request suspend and manage the user service
executables.omarchy: Keeps Omarchy's built-in idle locking disabled

executables.voxtype: Needed to run the dictation daemon
executables.wtype: Wayland typing driver used by this installation
executables.wl-copy: Used to copy transcriptions for paste mode and clipboard fallback
executables.wl-paste: Used to save the previous clipboard contents for restoration

paths..local/share/voxtype/models/ggml-large-v: Download the configured large-v3 model with voxtype setup --download --model large-v3
